title: Mahlanya RPG — Kingdom of Eswatini
short_description: Historical 3D RPG — Eswatini. Cattle economy, colonial resistance.
full_description:
MAHLANYA RPG — THE KINGDOM OF ESWATINI, 1750 TO 1906

Play as Mahlanya — meaning "the reckless one" in siSwati — a young Swazi man navigating four epochs of Eswatini history across an open world built from real geophysical data.

This is a historical RPG grounded in documented events: the pre-colonial Dlamini kingdom formation, the Mfecane upheaval of 1815–1840, the Battle of Lubombo in 1846, and the colonial resistance period ending with British annexation in 1906. Every terrain zone — Highveld granite escarpment, Middleveld agricultural valleys, Lowveld acacia savanna, Lubombo rhyolite plateau — is derived from GIS elevation sources.

★ THE CATTLE ECONOMY ★

Cattle are your wealth, political leverage, and spiritual capital. Lobola (cattle bride price) establishes kinship alliances. Tribute cattle cement chiefdom relationships. Raiding cattle from a rival polity is an act of war. Your Sibaya (cattle kraal) must be managed through seasons — drought reduces herd condition, raids can strip you overnight. Cattle determine which quests open and how chiefs receive you at their Umuti (homestead).

★ CULTURAL PROTOCOLS ★

Swazi society operates through Inhlonipho — avoidance vocabulary and respect obligations that govern how you address the Inkosi (chief) and greet elders. The game enforces these rules: wrong greetings close dialogue branches, disrespect has consequences. The game is voiced in siSwati with English subtitles throughout. Cultural ceremonies — the Incwala (first fruits ceremony) and Umhlanga (Reed Dance) — are historically grounded simulation events, not mini-games.

★ FOUR HISTORICAL ERAS ★

• Pre-colonial formation (~1750): Kingdom consolidation, diplomacy, tribute negotiations
• Mfecane upheaval (1815–1840): Regional disruption, refugee crises, shifting alliances
• Battle of Lubombo (1846): Playable historical engagement on the eastern escarpment
• Colonial resistance (1880–1906): Concession crisis, land alienation, Ngwenyama sovereignty under siege

A knowledge graph enforces historical accuracy — no NPC can assert a historically false claim. Emergent narrative: drought raises raid probability and generates related quests automatically.

★ OPTIMISED FOR ANDROID ★

Pre-baked terrain and pre-computed lighting deliver consistent performance across Android hardware. Hardware-adaptive NPC scaling (15 NPCs on LowEnd, 200 on Ultra). Fully offline after download — no internet required during play. Touch controls designed for Swazi terrain traversal with context-sensitive interaction prompts and a dedicated cattle management panel.

Google Play Games integration: achievements tracking historical milestones and cultural protocol mastery. Game controller support included.

★ CO-OP MULTIPLAYER ★

2–4 players for cattle raid and diplomatic escort missions. All cultural protocol rules apply to the full party. Collective cattle holdings and standing determine available options.

★ NO ADS. NO IN-APP PURCHASES. ★

Pay once. Play everything. No battle pass, no loot boxes, no microtransactions. The cattle economy in the game uses in-game cattle only — no real-money wagering of any kind.

Built by BRT Inc. in Manzini, Kingdom of Eswatini.
